# Harbor Retry Protocol
Synthetic fixture specification published by the Evaluation Standards Working Group (quality: high, primary within the corpus). It describes a test sender and receiver, not a production network. [[raw/clippings/Harbor Retry Protocol.md]]

## Specification claims (fixture rules)
- A receiver accepts a packet only when the payload digest matches the advertised checksum, and the sender keeps the same message identifier across retries.
- The trial rule permits three retries after the first transmission, four attempts in total, within an overall twelve-second deadline.
- A packet repeating an accepted identifier with the same digest is delivered to the application only once; the receiver resends its cached acknowledgement.
- A repeated identifier with a different digest is rejected as a conflict.
- Four permitted attempts are not four permitted application deliveries.

## Limits
The source states these values describe the fixture protocol and do not establish any empirical reliability rate. It supplies no throughput measurement and makes no claim about public-network packet loss. No empirical performance claim is drawn from it here.
EOF
